answer: I would anchor trust in Endorsed lifeboat crew record with lifeboat institution attestation. With launches the institution recorded across years of shouts, a single zenith check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. Each account presents its proof once, the network verifies it in seconds, and a farm that wants ten accounts must pass ten independent checks — the vault is that the work cannot be shared or replayed. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The reef grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
